1.Title: The Scorching Peaks
1.Text: The future is told, despite a fate unknown.
1.Story:
On the dust-covered land, the ruins have emerged.
A new star rises, between gods and demons.

2.Title: Icy Forest
2.Text: Follow the prophecy and discover your fate.
2.Story:
Cleanse the heretics and restore order,
Or forsake the old ways and revel in a new dawn.

3.Title: Oasis of Hope
3.Text: Walk through the fog, and your destination will be right ahead.
3.Story:
The earth trembles, and the storm is upon us.
A power awakens, as in our veins—runs the same blood.

4.Title: Secret Woods
4.Text: Destiny is unpredictable, and follows you like a shadow.
4.Story:
The ancient truth awakens,
As fate returns to its slumber.

5.Title: Towering Flora
5.Text: The hidden mysteries of fate always reveal themselves in the future.
5.Story:
The battle for truth shall unleash
waves of unrest and anarchy.
